small_guidance: Move the IC loop to be the innermost reduction with a BLOCK_K tile and accumulate via tl.dot: reshape the (kd,kh,kw,ic) gather into a K-tile of shape [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_K] and weights [BLOCK_K, BLOCK_N], so the 195-register/thread inner scalar FMA loop becomes tensor-core-friendly matmul. Also reduce register pressure by lowering BLOCK_M to 32 and using num_warps=8, num_stages=2, and add an @triton.autotune over {(32,32,16),(64,32,16),(32,64,16),(64,64,32)} keyed on (OC, SPATIAL, IC*KD*KH*KW). Fuse the BN (folded scale/shift) and mean-subtract directly into the conv epilogue to drop the two extra passes (~12% of time).
large_guidance: Rewrite as an explicit im2col-style GEMM for ConvTranspose3d: for each output tile (N, OC-tile, OD*OH*OW-tile), build a K = IC*KD*KH*KW reduction with input-gather indices computed once per (od,oh,ow,kd,kh,kw), and call tl.dot on [BM,BK] x [BK,BN] tiles so the work hits tensor cores instead of 6-deep scalar loops. Use channels-last (NDHWC) input layout so the K axis (IC contiguous) coalesces. Fold BatchNorm running stats into a per-channel (scale,shift) at module init (eval-style fold is fine since BN affine + running stats are constants for a forward pass), apply scale*acc+shift in the epilogue, then perform a two-pass fused mean-subtract: first pass writes pre-mean output and atomically accumulates per-(n,c) partial sums into a small buffer; second small kernel computes mean and subtracts. Alternatively, since SPATIAL per (n,c) is 64*64*32=131072, do an in-kernel persistent per-(n,c) reduction kernel separately but eliminate the redundant cudnn BN call entirely.
